scenarios.title: Electricity Disconnection Scam
scenarios.summary: A WhatsApp message threatens same-day disconnection and pushes a QR that pays an unknown account.
scenarios.message: URGENT: Your electricity connection will be disconnected today. Pay ₹1,999 immediately using the QR below.
scenarios.qrText:
PAYRAKSHA://demo-payment
recipient=unknown-electricity@demo
amount=1999
merchant=Electricity Board Demo
source=WhatsApp Demo
urgency=true
recipientVerified=false
scenario=utility_scam

scenarios.title: Legitimate Electricity Bill
scenarios.summary: Your usual monthly bill to a verified biller, raised inside the official demo app.
scenarios.message: Your electricity bill of ₹750 for September has been generated. You can pay it in the official app before the due date.
scenarios.qrText:
PAYRAKSHA://demo-payment
recipient=verified-electricity@demo
amount=750
merchant=Electricity Board (Verified Demo Biller)
note=Monthly electricity bill
source=Official Demo App
scenario=legit_utility
